description: Exact identity lookup on every site: a GTIN/EAN barcode, a manufacturer item number or a LEGO set number. Returns each site's matching product with its current shop offers in the locale's market (cheapest total first, each with its link) and the best price overall. Never a guess: no match means no site lists that exact product.

code.description: GTIN/EAN (8–14 digits), manufacturer item number or LEGO set number.

locale.description: Language and market (nl-NL = Dutch for the Netherlands, fr-BE = French for Belgium, de-DE = German for Germany, en-NL = English for the Netherlands; FR, DK and SE too). Shops, prices, currency and stock are per market; only sites that serve the locale answer. Default nl-NL.

sites.description: Only these sites (keys from list_sites, e.g. ["lofvi", "toolrango"]); default: every site.

name: find_by_code
title: Find shops for a barcode
